# zip_csv_response — zip→csv decode chain, pagination.none
# Boots the zip_csv scenario, runs one drain, and asserts the events JSONL and
# redacted trace JSONL match the golden. The body is a ZIP of two CSV members
# plus a README; the glob selects only the CSV members, which decode in
# name-sorted order with their rows concatenated.

exec skopos template show -o spec.yml zip_csv_response
replace spec.yml http://localhost:9999 $URL
exec skopos run -i spec.yml --once --trace trace.jsonl --out events.jsonl
normalize trace.jsonl
cmp trace.jsonl want_trace.jsonl
cmp events.jsonl want_events.jsonl

-- want_trace.jsonl --
{"elapsed":"<scrubbed>","iteration":1,"method":"GET","request_headers":{"Accept":"application/json, application/x-ndjson;q=0.9, */*;q=0.1"},"response_body":"body 513 bytes, non-json","started_at":"<scrubbed>","status":200,"url":"$URL_HOST/zip_csv/archive"}
-- want_events.jsonl --
{"id":"evt-000001","seq_num":"1","timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}
{"id":"evt-000002","seq_num":"2","timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:01Z"}
{"id":"evt-000003","seq_num":"3","timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:02Z"}
{"id":"evt-000004","seq_num":"4","timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:03Z"}
{"id":"evt-000005","seq_num":"5","timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:04Z"}
